name: woodstitch
description: Woodstitch: blinded human listening tests on text-to-speech audio, run by paid listeners, through an MCP server and a skill.

plugins.name: tts-human-eval
plugins.description: Paid human listeners judge your TTS audio blind: pairwise preference or human-vs-AI detection, with confidence intervals. Adds the Woodstitch MCP tools and a skill that knows when and how to run a listening test.
